summary: Imagine stepping into the boots of a junior astronaut, your textbook did not cover your first high stakes mission! Luckily you have your mentor Christina to help guide you through. Throughout the game a power outage accurs, Christina trusts you to fix it with the practice she gave you! Now, why did we make this game? We want to make Space and Sciience fun to learn about, with short games and interactive storylines. Complex textbooks can be hard and boring to understand with young learners and junior astronauts! Thats what truly inspired us.
details: Our project shifts Space and Science into a fun enjoyable game, for learners, juniors, and anyone to play and interact with! Using scratch, a kids coding app, we transformed our idea into a real working game ! We considered inspiring our mentor Christina with Christina Koch! (We credit Blob_thealien on picrew for using their character creator for Christina)
